title: Two Smiling Women & Toddler Girl on Beach, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot capturing two adult women relaxing in the sand beside a small toddler girl in a smocked dress playing with a sand pail and shovel. An embankment covered in ice plant and a vintage late-1930s automobile are visible in the background, evoking mid-century American family leisure and coastal outings.
